sofia: Following up on the vendor outage postmortem. Need to finalize owners for remediation and agree on a recurring incident-pattern review. Observed: 4 auth blips in the last 9 months, model-registry token expiry cascade once. Proposals: immediate secret rotations, staged failovers, quarterly vendor reliability review.

mike: I can consolidate action items into a GH issue. Will anyone volunteer to maintain the tracker?

ash: I can maintain the tracker and add links to runbooks + test plans. ETA: I'll have the initial tracker up in 24h.

liam: Security will handle secret rotation for the vendor integration. Also requesting automated smoke tests post-rotation. ETA: 72h.

jordan: I'll add runbook steps for emergency manual failover to internal auth provider. Also will work with PMs on SLA-based vendor escalation steps.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-45-followups created. Reminder scheduled for 72h.

sofia: I'll run a chaos test for token revocation tomorrow 9am PT in staging. Will need KMS access.

mike: Noted; infra please prioritize staging KMS.

ash: small fallback pseudocode for model-registry read path:
```
if (auth_error && cache_valid) {
  serve_from_cache();
  emit('fallback_served');
}
```

liam: Also recommending we add tracing headers to correlate auth failures across services (X-Auth-Trace).

mike: Good. Let's meet 10:30 PT to lock owners and put timelines into the postmortem doc.

(End of thread)
